# Invite accept — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for invite accept when an invitation needs its answer: one block over overlay, role picker and composer note. The invitation renders in the overlay modal on web and a sheet on native, named by the invitation, with `defaultOpen` opening the surface without a controlled flag. Role picking stays an inline picker by contract — never a nested modal, so focus never stacks two surfaces — and the accept note composes the composer in note mode, so the message field keeps the composer's own contract. `onAccept` receives the optional note and `onDecline` closes the loop, both host-owned, while role options, labels and the message toggle arrive as props, so the block adapts without forking.

## Native

### Features

Reach for invite accept when an invitation needs its answer: one block over overlay, role picker and composer note — the native twin under the same contract. The invitation renders in a sheet named by the invitation, with `defaultOpen` opening the surface without a controlled flag, and dismissal is platform-owned through back or swipe-down. Role picking stays an inline picker by contract — never a nested modal, so focus never stacks two surfaces — and the accept note composes the composer in note mode, so the message field keeps the composer's own contract. `onAccept` receives the optional note and `onDecline` closes the loop, both host-owned, while role options, labels and the message toggle arrive as props, so the block adapts without forking.
